description: This file contains the implementation of the RemindersTableManager class and the ReminderTableEntry class, which manage reminder entries stored in Azure Table Storage for Orleans. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting reminder entries, with logic for handling range queries and partition key construction.

classes.name: ReminderTableEntry
classes.description: Represents a reminder entry stored in Azure Table Storage, with properties for partition and row keys, and methods for constructing keys based on grain ID and reminder name.

classes.name: RemindersTableManager
classes.description: Manages CRUD operations for reminder entries in Azure Table Storage, including range queries, conditional deletes, and batch operations, with internal logic for handling partition keys and concurrency.

methods.name: ConstructRowKey
methods.description: Constructs the row key for a reminder entry based on grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ConstructRowKeyBounds
methods.description: Constructs the lower and upper bounds for row key range queries based on grain ID.

methods.name: ConstructPartitionKey
methods.description: Constructs the partition key for a reminder entry based on service ID and grain ID hash or number.

methods.name: ConstructPartitionKeyBounds
methods.description: Constructs the lower and upper bounds for partition key range queries based on service ID.

methods.name: FindReminderEntries
methods.description: Finds reminder entries within a specified range of partition keys or for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: FindReminderEntry
methods.description: Finds a specific reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: DeleteReminderEntryConditionally
methods.description: Deletes a reminder entry conditionally based on ETag to handle concurrency.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all reminder entries associated with the current service and deployment, grouped by grain hash.
